stem: How is the point of view in the poem different from that of the story?

options.label: A
options.text: Only the poem focuses on the thoughts of just one character.

options.label: B
options.text: Only the poem describes the motivation of a main character.

options.label: C
options.text: Only the poem shows the actions of just one character.

options.label: D
options.text: Only the poem explains how each character becomes involved in the situation.
